Home/Buy
For buyers

Buying a home in Toronto and the GTA

First condo or next family home, the process is the same: know what you can afford, understand the market, and don't let pressure make the decision for you.

Start your home searchEstimate your land transfer tax →

How buying works, in four stages

  1. 01

    Prepare

    We pin down what you need and a monthly cost you're comfortable with, closing costs included. Get a mortgage pre-approval early so the budget is real.

    What would make you regret this purchase in five years?

  2. 02

    Search

    You see recent sales in your areas before touring, then a short list that fits. For each serious contender we review comparables, condition and repair costs, plus the status certificate for condos.

    What would this home cost to own each month?

  3. 03

    Offer

    We set price, deposit, conditions and closing date for this home and this level of competition. I negotiate within limits we've agreed on together.

  4. 04

    Close

    I work with your lawyer, lender and inspector to keep deadlines and paperwork on track, and stay in touch after you move in.

Costs buyers often miss

  • Ontario land transfer tax
  • Toronto municipal land transfer tax, which applies in North York and the rest of the City of Toronto
  • First-time buyer rebates, if you qualify
  • Legal fees and title insurance
  • Home inspection and appraisal
  • Adjustments for prepaid property tax or condo fees

What I won't promise

I can't guarantee you'll win a bidding war or buy below asking. I can promise a clear strategy, honest advice, and that you'll never sign an offer you don't understand.
